- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant offered 10 tips for effectively using a Gantt chart to track project progress and dependencies, including:
  1. Keep it simple and focused
  2. Define clear task dependencies
  3. Use realistic task durations
  4. Update the chart regularly
  5. Focus on the critical path
  6. Use colors and symbols effectively
  7. Create a baseline
  8. Zoom in and out
  9. Share with your team
  10. Review and adjust
